129.name: First Aid
129.description: Higher first aid skill allows you to learn higher level first aid abilities.  First aid abilities can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters.

164.name: Blacksmithing
164.description: Higher smithing skill allows you to learn higher level smithing plans.  Blacksmithing plans can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

165.name: Leatherworking
165.description: Higher leatherworking skill allows you to learn higher level leatherworking patterns.  Leatherworking patterns can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

171.name: Alchemy
171.description: Higher alchemy skill allows you to learn higher level alchemy recipes.  Alchemy recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

182.name: Herbalism
182.description: Higher herbalism skill allows you to harvest more difficult herbs around the world.  If you cannot harvest a specific herb, then increase your skill by harvesting easier to gather herbs in lower level areas.

185.name: Cooking
185.description: Higher cooking skill allows you to learn higher level cooking recipes.  Recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters.

186.name: Mining
186.description: Higher mining skill allows you to harvest more difficult minerals nodes around the world.  If you cannot harvest a specific mineral, then increase your skill by mining easier to mine minerals in lower level areas.

197.name: Tailoring
197.description: Higher tailoring skill allows you to learn higher level tailoring patterns.  Tailoring patterns can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

202.name: Engineering
202.description: Higher engineering skill allows you to learn higher level engineering schematics.  Schematics can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

333.name: Enchanting
333.description: Higher enchanting skill allows you to learn more powerful formulae.  Formulae can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

356.name: Fishing
356.description: Higher fishing skill increases your chance of catching fish in bodies of water around the world.  If you are having trouble catching fish in a given area, move to a lower level area or purchase a fishing lure and try again.

393.name: Skinning
393.description: Higher skinning skill allows you to skin hides from higher level monsters around the world.    Once your skill is above 100, you can divide your skill by 5 to determine the highest level of monster you can skin.

2933.name: Test Profession [DNT]
2933.description: Higher skill allows you to learn higher level recipes.  Recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters.
